name: Volume Data Loading and Normalization
definition: A C++ class for loading 3D and 4D volume data from .npy files, normalizing values, and managing frame indices for time-varying volumes.
summary: Volume Data Loading and Normalization loads 3D or 4D volumetric data from NumPy files and normalizes values by subtracting the minimum, differing from standard methods by preserving absolute magnitude rather than scaling to a fixed range.
